description: How many deadly earthquakes, tsunamis and eruptions has this place seen since 1900?. Give a point (lat, lon) and a radius. Returns NOAA NCEI significant earthquake, tsunami and volcanic eruption records within that radius since a chosen year: counts by kind, published deaths on the records, strongest quake magnitude and the five deadliest records with distance. Plus a per-decade table. Counts and distances computed by Lilambd from NOAA records; no personal data. Routes: /; /answer (lat*, lon*, radius_km, since); /decades (kind, limit, offset). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /, /answer, /decades. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: disaster-exposure
